New plan: 

I failed to apply the backdoor criterion correctly to determine if having a sister positively affects heart condition through blood pressure. Specifically, I did not properly estimate the effect of H on HC, conditioning on BP. 

To correct this, I should have calculated the ratio of the probabilities of a healthy heart given high blood pressure and having a sister, to the probabilities of a healthy heart given high blood pressure and not having a sister. This would give me the effect of H on HC, conditioning on BP.

P(HC | BP=High, H) / P(HC | BP=High, ~H) = 0.41 / 0.31 ≈ 1.322

This means that having a sister increases the probability of a healthy heart by approximately 32.2% (1.322 - 1), even when conditioning on high blood pressure. This suggests that having a sister may positively affect heart condition through blood pressure.
